verdicts.reason: A: '20% off' clearly dominates and the can stays recognisable, but the Shop Sale button sits before the headline (CTA first, so the reading order runs backwards), 'WEEKEND ONLY' is tiny and separated from the offer, and the four-line legal block is jammed against the right edge. B: the headline is broken into a cramped two-line '20% / off', the body copy wraps to three lines, the can shrinks to an unrecognisable sliver, and 'WEEKEND ONLY' sits far right, cut off from the offer it qualifies, above legal text about as large as the body copy.
